confirmation: A pass is a discovery; the identical candidate runtime must pass the same rule on the next unopened tranche.

coverage_on_matched.note: share of gold-matched rows whose prediction supplies a carrier value

definition: For every gold row with an asserted carrier value: |gold - predicted|, where predicted is the paired paper-derived prediction's supplied carrier value, or 0 when the row was not paired or the prediction supplied no value (identity miss and abstention both count as the full error). Mean over the tranche's asserted rows; PMID-cluster paired bootstrap.

end_to_end_mae.note: candidate minus baseline, carriers per asserted gold row

identity_guard.note: Same one-sided 95% PMID-cluster lower bounds as the primary rule, plus observed recall delta >= 0 (Grok 4.6 review, added before the tranche 02 candidate lock); counts may not improve by dropping identities.

role: secondary; the identity rule in registry.json stays primary and its verdicts stand
